name: com.mindfulgive/charities
title: Mindful Give Charity Finder
description: Find charities and get a link to their Mindful Give giving page. Read-only.

tools.name: find_charities
tools.description: Search the charities that take gifts on Mindful Give by name. Returns each match with its giving page URL to hand to the donor. This tool only looks charities up and returns a link: it never takes a payment. The donor completes the gift themselves on the charity's giving page, and the charity issues the official tax receipt.

query.description: Part of the charity's name, e.g. "Sacred Heart".

limit.description: How many charities to return (1-10, default 5).

tools.name: get_charity
tools.description: Get one charity's public details (name, legal name, location, short description, whether it issues tax receipts) and its giving page URL, by its slug (from find_charities). This tool only looks charities up and returns a link: it never takes a payment. The donor completes the gift themselves on the charity's giving page, and the charity issues the official tax receipt.

slug.description: The charity's slug, as returned by find_charities.
